roleContext.jobDescription: A payroll-software company is retiring its legacy job scheduler and moving about 150 internal services to a new orchestration platform over eighteen months. The technical program manager runs the cross-team plan, keeps the RAID log, coordinates readiness reviews with service owners, security and support, publishes weekly status and represents the programme to senior leadership. When migration waves slip or teams disagree on sequencing, the program manager takes the question to the directors with options and is expected to come back with a recorded decision.

requirements.text: Runs the cross-team programme plan for migrating internal services to the new orchestration platform.
Maintains the programme's risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID) log.
Coordinates migration readiness reviews with service owners, security and support.
Represents the programme to senior leadership and handles director-level escalations.
Publishes a weekly programme status report.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Technical Program Manager, Platform Migration

## Experience

- Technical program manager at Strata Ledger (accounting software), September 2021 to present, running the plan for moving 120 internal services from the legacy job scheduler to the new orchestration platform in six waves.
- Kept the programme RAID log, reviewing open risks and dependencies with the service owners every Tuesday and closing items only once the owning team had confirmed them.
- Ran readiness reviews for each migration wave with the service owners, the security team and customer support, using a checklist that covered rollback, alerting and support handover.
- Calm, inspiring presence in any crisis, with the kind of executive presence that senior stakeholders instinctively trust.
- Published the weekly programme status report (waves completed, services blocked, top risks) to the engineering directors' mailing list, with a short section on any wave whose date had moved since the previous week.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the readiness checklist used for migration wave 4, completed for 18 services, with the rollback test result, alert ownership and support sign-off recorded for each service.
